title:
SilverBullet Official Launch
 – Silver Bullet Tools
description: After years of study, hand-machined prototypes, testing and refining, the Silver Bullet is officially in production. It took over a year of designing, drafting and material selection to get to where we are today: the Silver Bullet - the world's most adaptable and capable disc-lock picking tool is available.
